children: Santa Fe Bio, the joint venture between Argentina's oil company YPF and Essential Energy, announced an agreement with TotalEnergies
for the supply of sustainable aviation fuel, it said in a statement on Wednesday.
The agreement involves an investment of over $400 million for  the redevelopment of the San Lorenzo industrial complex, it added.
